test.expected_result: OpenArt adapter tests verify no-live worker packets and Studio browser smoke creates the AI Video Worker Handoff card.

actions.label: Plan Studio Repair
actions.expected_behavior: Creates a Studio-only repair plan with file/route/test allowlists and explicit no-shell/no-deploy/no-external-write constraints.

test.expected_result: tests/one-time-studio-sidekick-policy.test.js verifies allowed and denied repair requests; UI test verifies the handler.

actions.label: Preview Correction
actions.expected_behavior: Previews a reversible correction patch without mutating data or making external calls.

test.expected_result: Correction previews are reversible and no-write; broad patches require confirmation when applied.

actions.label: Apply Preview
actions.expected_behavior: Applies the currently previewed reversible correction patch to the scoped project after confirmation.

test.expected_result: Route enforces scoped project access and broad correction confirmation.

actions.label: Save Scene
actions.expected_behavior: Updates a scoped storyboard scene and appends a scene-version snapshot.

test.expected_result: Scene route loads owner project/workspace before update.

actions.label: Run Mock Render
actions.expected_behavior: Runs a deterministic local mock render, creates local assets/usage, and performs no external write.

test.expected_result: Mock job output has local assets and external_write_performed=false.

actions.label: Create Content Handoff
actions.expected_behavior: Creates an idempotent local Content job/output handoff only; no publish, send, schedule, upload, access grant, payment, or external CRM write.

test.expected_result: Domain test verifies no-publish idempotency and browser smoke creates a mocked local handoff.

actions.label: View One Time as Rabbi
actions.selector_hint: One Time workspace option in the Operations workspace switcher
actions.expected_behavior: Switches the Operations workspace context into the One Time provider view without mutating records or exposing unrelated workspace data.

test.expected_result: Operations workspace taxonomy smoke confirms One Time view is scoped and Super Admin can intentionally switch back.

actions.label: Run One Time member-library verification
actions.expected_behavior: Runs the bounded member-library verification check only with APPROVE_ONE_TIME_MEMBER_LIBRARY_PUBLISHING and preserves rollback evidence.

test.expected_result: tests/one-time-member-library.test.js verifies the exact approval phrase and smoke/rollback path.

actions.label: Preview One Time class package
actions.expected_behavior: Previews the selected One Time class package and linked assets without publishing, sending, billing, Drive/video-host, social, or external CRM writes.

test.expected_result: Preview endpoint returns package data and no external write flags.

actions.label: Preview One Time member visibility
actions.expected_behavior: Shows whether the selected package would be visible for the chosen member tier without changing member-library state.

test.expected_result: Member preview endpoint performs no publish or notification writes.

actions.label: Approve One Time member-library package
actions.expected_behavior: Records internal package approval only when the exact member-library approval phrase is present; it does not publish or notify members.

test.expected_result: Server approve-library route requires APPROVE_ONE_TIME_MEMBER_LIBRARY_PUBLISHING and appends audit evidence.

actions.label: Publish One Time member-library package
actions.expected_behavior: Publishes a member-library item only after explicit destination, tier visibility, and APPROVE_ONE_TIME_MEMBER_LIBRARY_PUBLISHING; previous published item is archived for rollback.

test.expected_result: tests/one-time-member-library.test.js verifies approval phrase, member-library readback, and rollback path.

actions.label: Rollback One Time member-library item
actions.expected_behavior: Archives the selected member-library item with a rollback note and keeps the source class package intact.

test.expected_result: Rollback endpoint records archived state and live smoke confirms item no longer appears in member-library readback.

actions.label: Dry-run send live Zoom links
actions.expected_behavior: Calculates eligible/skipped recipients for a One Time live session and returns a summary without sending messages.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/live-sessions/:id/send-zoom-link defaults to dryRun=true and reports no sends.

actions.label: Send live Zoom links
actions.expected_behavior: Sends the current Zoom link only after the explicit Operations confirmation prompt and project-scoped recipient resolution.

test.expected_result: UI requires confirm before dryRun=false; server scopes recipients to the live-session project.

actions.label: Generate parent access code
actions.expected_behavior: Generates or rotates one parent access code only after an explicit confirmation prompt and shows the raw code once.

test.expected_result: Operations UI confirms rotation and server endpoint is admin-only.

actions.label: Open parent portal link
actions.expected_behavior: Creates a short-lived parent portal link and opens it locally; no email or WhatsApp send runs.

test.expected_result: UI calls parent-access/link with send_email=false and send_whatsapp=false for open mode.

actions.label: Email parent portal login link
actions.expected_behavior: Sends one short-lived parent portal login link by email through the admin-only parent access endpoint.

test.expected_result: Single-family email link action stays on explicit per-parent button and is not a bulk campaign.

actions.label: WhatsApp parent portal login link
actions.expected_behavior: Sends one short-lived parent portal login link by WhatsApp only after an explicit confirmation prompt and SEND_WHATSAPP server confirmation token.

test.expected_result: Server rejects WhatsApp sends unless confirm is SEND_WHATSAPP.

actions.label: Preview parent password setup
actions.expected_behavior: Shows the parent password setup/reset email preview with dry_run=true and no email send.

test.expected_result: Password setup endpoint returns dry_run=true, no_send=true, and external_write_performed=false.

actions.label: Email parent password setup
actions.expected_behavior: Sends one password setup/reset email only after the explicit UI confirmation and SEND_PARENT_PASSWORD_SETUP server confirmation token.

test.expected_result: Server rejects non-dry-run password setup unless confirm is SEND_PARENT_PASSWORD_SETUP.

actions.label: Open setup page
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the static credential-safe owner setup center.

test.expected_result: Operations owner setup panel links to /integration-setup.html and the route registry marks it credential-safe.

actions.label: Run validation
actions.expected_behavior: Calls the protected owner setup readiness endpoint and displays success or blocker status without secrets.

test.expected_result: Button calls GET /api/bna/integration-setup/readiness through the Operations API client and performs no external write.

actions.label: Open review context
actions.expected_behavior: Creates one short-lived server-side role/workspace-scoped review session after owner auth and CSRF validation, then opens the review shell.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/agent-review/sessions requires CSRF and returns all_access_secret_in_url=false.

actions.label: Open scoped route
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the target route for the selected review context with a non-secret session reference, not an all-access token.

test.expected_result: Review session target URL includes agent_review_session=<session_ref> and no owner credential.

actions.label: Exit review context
actions.expected_behavior: Revokes the current short-lived review session and returns to the owner hub.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/agent-review/sessions/exit revokes the scoped token.

actions.label: Submit Agent Review Result
actions.expected_behavior: Persists an idempotent typed Agent Review result linked to raw/source, parent goal, requirement, role/workspace, routes, helper outcomes, evidence, severity, correction, and timestamp.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/agent-review/results returns result_ref and Operations readback URL.

actions.label: Open Agent Mode prompt
actions.expected_behavior: Opens one mobile-copyable Agent Mode prompt file from the Issue #24 prompt pack.

test.expected_result: Prompt index has 15 files and each prompt references the Agent Review Hub and typed result endpoint.

actions.label: Start Audit
actions.expected_behavior: Creates or returns an in-progress AGR record for the prompt before Copy Agent Prompt is allowed, preserving prompt key, run, requirement, owner, context, started_at, status, and idempotency key.

test.expected_result: POST /api/bna/agent-review/prompts/start requires CSRF, returns an AGR ref/readback, and Copy Agent Prompt auto-starts if needed.

actions.label: Hub
actions.expected_behavior: Returns from a review session shell to the owner Agent Review Hub.

test.expected_result: Hub link targets /operations/agent-review.

actions.label: Copy session URL
actions.expected_behavior: Copies the current short-lived scoped review session URL for Agent Mode handoff without exposing owner credentials.

test.expected_result: Copy action uses the current review-shell URL and does not copy passwords, cookies, or API keys.

actions.label: Copy prompt
actions.expected_behavior: Copies the mobile-friendly Agent Mode prompt only after Start Audit has created or returned the in-progress AGR record, then includes agent_review_run_id, prompt_key, return_url, dropoff_url, requirement_id, result_ref, and idempotency_key metadata.

test.expected_result: Copied prompt file includes the required drop-off metadata and no reusable all-access secret.

actions.label: Open drop-off
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the owner or scoped-session Agent Review result drop-off form for the selected prompt and context.

test.expected_result: Drop-off page loads prompt context, accepts plain text or JSON, and saves through POST /api/bna/agent-review/results.

actions.label: Mark blocked
actions.expected_behavior: Saves a BLOCKED Agent Review result through the typed result API when a scoped context cannot be safely opened.

test.expected_result: BLOCKED save returns AGR result_ref, repair item, and rerun prompt.

actions.label: View saved result
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the owner-only readback for a saved AGR result.

test.expected_result: Readback requires owner auth and returns the saved result_ref without secrets.

actions.label: Rerun after repair
actions.expected_behavior: Opens a rerun/drop-off path linked to the repair item created for a FAIL or BLOCKED Agent Review result.

test.expected_result: FAIL/BLOCKED result exposes a repair requirement link and rerun prompt.

actions.label: Open One Time tasks
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the task manager filtered to the identity's One Time project scope for scoped Studio/video worker sessions.

test.expected_result: One Time AI video worker allowedViews includes tasks and server guard permits only scoped task routes.

actions.label: Open One Time task
actions.selector_hint: task detail/open controls that call selectTask or set selectedTaskId
actions.expected_behavior: Opens a task detail record only after the task API confirms it belongs to the scoped One Time project.

test.expected_result: assertTaskAccess rejects non-One-Time task ids for scoped worker sessions.

actions.label: Save One Time task
actions.selector_hint: task editor controls that call updateTask
actions.expected_behavior: Creates or updates only task-manager fields for records inside the scoped One Time project.

test.expected_result: opsScopeProjectKey forces created and updated task records into one_time_mishnah_class for scoped worker sessions.

actions.label: Comment on One Time task
actions.selector_hint: task comment controls that post to /api/bna/tasks/:id/comments
actions.expected_behavior: Adds comments only to One Time project tasks and defaults One Time task comments to project visibility.

test.expected_result: assertTaskAccess runs before comments are read or inserted for scoped worker sessions.

actions.label: Task Agent Mode workflow
actions.expected_behavior: Shows the Agent Mode prompt, status, owner-clarity, drop-off form, AGR result readback, and rerun prompt for visible owner Tasks or Decisions that need human/browser action.

test.expected_result: Sample owner Task and Decision cards expose prompt metadata and a PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED drop-off flow without creating duplicate visible Tasks.

actions.label: Copy Agent Mode prompt
actions.expected_behavior: Copies the task/Decision Agent Mode prompt and records prompt_copied_at/status on the original card through POST /api/bna/tasks/:id/agent-mode/copy-prompt.

test.expected_result: Copying changes the card status to prompt_copied and keeps the same idempotency key.

actions.label: Open task start URL
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the exact task or Decision card starting URL included in the Agent Mode prompt.

test.expected_result: Starting URL returns to /operations?view=tasks&task=<id> without exposing a reusable all-access secret.

actions.label: Open task drop-off
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the task/Decision-specific Agent Review drop-off URL with task_id, prompt_key, requirement_id, and idempotency_key.

test.expected_result: Drop-off context resolves the original task and returns owner_task_decision prompt metadata.

actions.label: Save task Agent Review result
actions.expected_behavior: Saves PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED through the typed Agent Review result API, attaches the AGR evidence to the original task, and creates or links repair/rerun metadata for FAIL/BLOCKED.

test.expected_result: PASS attaches an AGR proof link; BLOCKED creates a repair task and rerun prompt.

actions.label: View task AGR result
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the owner-only AGR result readback linked from the original task card.

test.expected_result: Future GitHub-connected Codex sessions can read the saved result through Operations readback and repo evidence.

actions.label: Open Agent Mode repair
actions.expected_behavior: Opens the repair task created or linked after a FAIL/BLOCKED task Agent Review result.

test.expected_result: FAIL/BLOCKED result links a repair task and exposes a rerun prompt on the original card.

actions.label: Provider setup help
actions.expected_behavior: Allows a provider-scoped assistant/setup flow to coach account/listing setup only; no Codex CLI, shell, deploy, migration, secret copy, external send, payment, or access grant is available.
actions.permission: authenticated provider account with account_setup_bot entitlement

test.expected_result: tests/assistant-scope-policy.test.js allows provider_setup_help for free providers and blocks Codex CLI routing.

actions.label: Save inquiry draft
actions.expected_behavior: Saves a provider inquiry response draft only and returns explicit no_send/external_write_performed=false metadata.
actions.permission: authenticated provider account with parent_contact_reply_bot entitlement

test.expected_result: POST /api/provider-portal/inquiries/:id/response-draft is provider-scoped and draft-only; tests/crm-contact-model.test.js verifies free provider inquiry inbox access.

actions.label: Search mailbox
actions.expected_behavior: Searches the Rabbi / One Time provider mailbox thread list using the private provider mailbox API; reads only scoped bna_communications email rows and performs no external send.
actions.permission: authenticated One Time provider workspace member

test.expected_result: GET /api/provider-portal/mailbox is provider-session gated, One Time scoped, and returns readiness without secrets or physical address text.

actions.label: Open mailbox thread
actions.expected_behavior: Loads a scoped One Time email thread timeline from bna_communications using the private provider mailbox thread API.
actions.permission: authenticated One Time provider workspace member

test.expected_result: GET /api/provider-portal/mailbox/:threadKey requires provider session and Rabbi / One Time workspace scope.

actions.label: Save mailbox draft
actions.expected_behavior: Saves a local One Time mailbox reply draft in bna_communications with no_send/external_write_performed=false metadata.
actions.permission: authenticated One Time provider workspace member

test.expected_result: POST /api/provider-portal/mailbox/:threadKey/draft logs a local draft only and does not call Resend send.

actions.label: Send mailbox reply
actions.expected_behavior: Sends a one-to-one One Time mailbox reply through Resend only after provider session, workspace scope, Resend readiness, and exact SEND_RESEND_EMAIL confirmation; bulk email remains unavailable.

test.expected_result: POST /api/provider-portal/mailbox/:threadKey/send uses resendIntegration.sendResendEmail with confirmation and records external action audit; no bulk campaign endpoint is created.

actions.label: Provider calendar
actions.expected_behavior: Shows provider-scoped calendar readback. External calendar writes are disabled from the provider portal until a separate approval-gated manage flow exists.

actions.disabled_reason: Current package merge exposes readback only; no external calendar mutation control is rendered.

test.expected_result: GET /api/provider-portal/calendar-events returns scoped local events with no_external_calendar_write=true.

actions.label: Request Provider Plus
actions.expected_behavior: Shows upgrade CTA for paid provider portals/CRM/reporting without granting access, charging, or changing entitlement rows.

test.expected_result: Free provider parent/student portal cards show upgrade-required state and do not enable paid portals.

actions.label: Add contact
actions.expected_behavior: Creates or updates one workspace-scoped first-party CRM contact, writes workspace-scoped email/phone/WhatsApp identities when provided, records a local pipeline event, opens the contact workspace, and performs no email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access grant, import, historical sync, or external CRM write. test.expected_result: tests/shared-crm-workbench-contract.test.js verifies the POST route is workspace-scoped and no-send; the One Time CRM workbench local smoke verifies the Add Contact form is visible without submitting a production write.

actions.label: Filter CRM contacts
actions.expected_behavior: Filters first-party BNA CRM contacts inside the selected workspace/project; performs no email, WhatsApp, social, payment, access, or external CRM writes.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM entitlements

test.expected_result: tests/crm-contact-model.test.js verifies entitlement-gated filtering and no-send model.

actions.label: Open CRM contact
actions.expected_behavior: Expands a local first-party CRM contact and timeline readback only; no message is sent.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with contact_timeline entitlement

test.expected_result: GET /api/bna/crm/contacts/:id/timeline returns no_send/external_write_performed=false; tests/crm-contact-model.test.js verifies timeline no-send fields.

actions.label: Open contact mailbox
actions.expected_behavior: Moves from the selected local CRM contact to the scoped Rabbi / One Time email inbox while preserving selected contact context; does not send, draft-send, charge, grant access, import, or write to an external CRM.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM entitlements

test.expected_result: One Time CRM workbench exposes a mailbox shortcut that routes to the Rabbi inbox with workspace=rabbi_sheller_provider and project_key=one_time_mishnah_class.

actions.label: Open email thread

test.expected_result: Shared CRM workbench contract verifies the scoped inbox action is registered and visible only as navigation.

actions.label: Start WhatsApp conversation

actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM entitlement

test.expected_result: tests/shared-crm-workbench-contract.test.js verifies the shared CRM action helper builds a wa.me link and unavailable tooltip.

actions.label: Create task
actions.expected_behavior: Creates exactly one first-party local CRM follow-up task for the selected contact only after an explicit click; no email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access grant, import, historical sync, or external CRM write runs. The action is disabled only in read-only preview.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM entitlement

test.expected_result: tests/shared-crm-workbench-contract.test.js verifies the active Create task action calls the scoped CRM PATCH path with create_follow_up_task=true and no-send/no-external-write flags.

actions.label: Complete task
actions.expected_behavior: Marks the selected contact's linked first-party CRM follow-up task complete only after an explicit click; no email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access grant, import, historical sync, or external CRM write runs. The action is disabled in read-only preview or when the linked task is already complete.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM/task entitlement

test.expected_result: tests/shared-crm-workbench-contract.test.js verifies the action calls PATCH /api/bna/tasks/:id with stage=done/completed_at and no external-write copy; the One Time CRM workbench local smoke verifies the button is visible for a linked task.

actions.label: Reopen task
actions.expected_behavior: Reopens the selected contact's completed linked first-party CRM follow-up task only after an explicit click; no email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access grant, import, historical sync, or external CRM write runs. The action is disabled in read-only preview or when the linked task is not complete.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM/task entitlement

test.expected_result: tests/shared-crm-workbench-contract.test.js verifies the action calls PATCH /api/bna/tasks/:id with stage=assigned, clears completion fields, and preserves no external-write copy; the One Time CRM workbench local smoke verifies the button is visible for a linked task.

actions.label: Link member
actions.expected_behavior: Creates or reuses a first-party disabled member shell for the selected workspace CRM contact only after an explicit click; the payload uses access_status=paused and access_enabled=false, creates no portal link or access code, grants no library/class access, sends no message, charges no payment, performs no import, and writes no external CRM record. The action is disabled in read-only preview and when the contact has no email.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM/member entitlement

test.expected_result: tests/shared-crm-workbench-contract.test.js verifies the action calls POST /api/bna/members with access_status=paused, access_enabled=false, and no external-write/access-copy; the One Time CRM workbench local smoke verifies the button is visible without clicking the write.

actions.label: Archive contact
actions.expected_behavior: Archives the selected workspace-scoped first-party CRM contact only after an explicit click and confirmation, hides it from active CRM lists, records a local pipeline event through the CRM PATCH route, and performs no email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access grant, import, automatic task creation, historical sync, or external CRM write. The action is disabled in read-only preview.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM entitlements

test.expected_result: tests/shared-crm-workbench-contract.test.js verifies Archive Contact uses status=archived, create_follow_up_task=false, and no external-write flags; the One Time CRM workbench local smoke verifies the action is visible without clicking it.

actions.label: Save CRM update
actions.expected_behavior: Saves status, tags, owner, follow-up date, and internal note to first-party local CRM tables only; no email, WhatsApp, Telegram, payment, access grant, import, historical sync, or external CRM write runs.
actions.permission: super_admin or scoped provider workspace role with CRM entitlements; disabled in read-only View-as Rabbi mode

test.expected_result: PATCH /api/bna/crm/contacts/:id returns no_send=true and external_write_performed=false; View-as requests with X-One-Time-View-As-Token are rejected for non-GET methods.

actions.expected_behavior: Deny Codex CLI, shell, deploy, migration, Railway mutation, secret-copy, external send, payment, access-grant, and DNS actions from web/portal assistants.
